clue.text: Get bogged down after loot taken by half of German general staff?

indicators.note: after places the piece meaning get bogged down later in the answer than the loot

parts.note: swag is slang for stolen goods or loot

indicators.note: German has six letters and only its first three are taken, so half of the word is used

parts.note: to stick is to get stuck, bogged down

explanation.surface: A soldier mired in mud after plundering, while German top brass look on.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: a swagger stick is a short cane carried by military officers, so a staff for a general, playing on the 'general staff' of an army.
explanation.definitionFit: A swagger stick is the short cane an officer carries, a playful kind of staff borne by a general.

clue.text: Tool for republicans' objective!

definitions.meaning: an implement for scraping paint or mud off surfaces
read as ..., getting rid of the monarch (ER, Elizabeth Regina), which is what anti-monarchists want

explanation.walkthrough: ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen; British republicans aim to scrap the monarchy, so the second reading splits the answer as SCRAP ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand implement for removing paint or dirt from a surface is called by this name.

clue.text: Take possession of girl with kiss

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name
X is the written sign for a kiss

explanation.surface: Someone claims a girl as their own with a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: To annex territory is to seize it and take it over as one's own.

clue.text: Legendary queen always visiting African country briefly

indicators.note: visiting means one piece goes to stay inside the other
briefly means the country's name is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: Guinea is a country in West Africa
ever means always, as in 'ever hopeful'

explanation.surface: A queen of legend is forever touring a country in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' drops the last letter of the country's name, giving GUINE, and 'visiting' sets the word for always inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Guinevere is King Arthur's queen in the Arthurian legends.

clue.text: Ceremony just broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means the word is heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: just means fair or right

explanation.surface: A ceremony has only just gone out on air.
explanation.definitionFit: A rite is a formal religious or solemn ceremony.

clue.text: Resolution: enact it in some form before start of year

indicators.note: in some form means the letters are put into another arrangement
start of takes only the opening letter of the word year

explanation.surface: A New Year's resolution: enact it in some way before the year begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in some form' rearranges ENACTIT to TENACIT, and 'start of' gives Y from year.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolution in the sense of firm determination is a synonym of tenacity.

clue.text: Caught one flushed that's taken up drink

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: in a down clue, taken up means this piece is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: flushed means red in the face

explanation.surface: A man caught red-faced who has started drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'taken up' reads the colour upwards, giving DER, so the drink is not hidden among the clue's words.
explanation.definitionFit: Cider is an alcoholic drink made from fermented apples.

clue.text: Song concerning idle fellow

parts.note: a lay is an old word for a song or ballad
about means concerning

explanation.surface: A song about a lazy man.
explanation.definitionFit: A layabout is a lazy person who avoids work.

clue.text: Engineers fast to yield

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
Lent is the Christian period of fasting

explanation.surface: Engineers go on hunger strike until the other side gives way.
explanation.definitionFit: To relent is to soften and give way after resisting.

clue.text: Canine hero runs in adventure cartoon

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
Tintin is the Belgian comic-strip boy reporter of adventure stories

explanation.surface: A heroic dog dashes into a cartoon adventure.
explanation.definitionFit: Rin Tin Tin was a famous German Shepherd star of Hollywood films.

clue.text: Sea-dog died dissolute

parts.note: a rake is a dissolute man; the adjective stands in for him

explanation.surface: An old sailor who died after a life of debauchery.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Francis Drake was the Elizabethan English sea captain and privateer.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis Drake is the archetypal Elizabethan sea captain, an old salt.

clue.text: Brownies team tucking into food

indicators.note: tucking into means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: pies are a kind of food
XI is eleven in Roman numerals, a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: Junior Girl Guides eating their food as a team.
explanation.walkthrough: Brownies are both the junior Girl Guides of the surface and small helpful sprites of folklore.
explanation.definitionFit: Brownies in folklore are little household sprites, much like elves and other fairy folk.

clue.text: Neckwear used by top gangster

parts.note: a scarf is worn round the neck
ace means top, excellent

explanation.surface: A leading mobster wears a scarf.
explanation.walkthrough: Scarface was the nickname of Al Capone, and the title of gangster films.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarface was Al Capone's nickname and the name of a celebrated film mobster.

clue.text: Old tennis champ in posh car taking less care

indicators.note: in places the champion inside the car

parts.note: RR is Rolls-Royce, the luxury car
Arthur Ashe won Wimbledon in 1975

explanation.surface: A retired tennis star drives a Rolls more recklessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Rasher is a comparative of rash, meaning more careless or reckless.

clue.text: Small person making an impression as an athlete

parts.note: a printer makes impressions on paper

explanation.surface: A small person trying to impress, as a sportsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprinter is an athlete who runs short races.

clue.text: Porter carrying paintings set off

indicators.note: carrying means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, like stout
paintings are art

explanation.surface: A railway porter carrying pictures sets out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Porter' looks like a baggage carrier; it is the dark beer.
explanation.definitionFit: To start out is to set off on a journey.

clue.text: European town like Barcelona in vogue documentary

indicators.note: in places the European town inside the vogue

parts.note: the rage is what is in vogue
Barcelona is a port

explanation.surface: A fashionable documentary about a Spanish city.
explanation.definitionFit: Reportage is factual, journalistic reporting, the kind found in documentary work.

clue.text: Point to titles being edited

indicators.note: being edited means the letters are reorganised

explanation.surface: An editor is pointed towards titles that are being revised.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiletto is a slim dagger with a sharp point, or a tapering spiked heel.

clue.text: Naval vessel and similar things returned carrying soldiers (old one)

indicators.note: carrying means the first piece holds the others inside
returned means the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: etc, et cetera, means and similar things
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers
a vet, short for veteran, is an old soldier

explanation.surface: A warship and such like came back with troops, including a veteran.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' reverses the abbreviation to CTE, and 'carrying' sets ORVET inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A corvette is a small, fast naval warship used for escort duties.

clue.text: Bashful takes Doc's stuff — that's funny

indicators.note: takes means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: coy means bashful
med, short for medicine, is what a doctor dispenses

explanation.surface: Two of the Seven Dwarfs, Bashful and Doc, in a comic scene.
explanation.walkthrough: Bashful and Doc look like Snow White's dwarfs; Bashful is COY and Doc's stuff is MED.
explanation.definitionFit: Comedy is the genre of humorous entertainment, the stuff that amuses.

clue.text: It's just too much being held by agent with acne

indicators.note: being held by means this piece sits within the other

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
OTT means over the top, simply too much

explanation.surface: A secret agent finds his acne is all too much.
explanation.definitionFit: Spotty describes skin covered in pimples, as with acne.

clue.text: Harry and Mary to get job on farm

indicators.note: to harry is to harass or disturb, so the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: Harry and Mary are hoping to find work on a farm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Harry' looks like a name; it is the anagram signal for ANDMARY.
explanation.definitionFit: A yardman is a farm labourer who works in the farmyard.

clue.text: People add up in the head

parts.note: men means people
to tally is to add up

explanation.surface: People doing sums in their heads.
explanation.definitionFit: Mentally means within the mind, as with mental arithmetic.

clue.text: Passage taken from Zola is legible

explanation.surface: A passage from Zola is easy to read.
explanation.definitionFit: An aisle is a passageway between rows of seats.

clue.text: Empty bar on vessel needed drinks supplier

indicators.note: Empty means the word is emptied of its middle, leaving the outside letters

parts.note: a ewer is a large jug

explanation.surface: An empty bar on a ship needed someone to provide beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A brewer makes beer and so supplies drinks.

clue.text: Hotel broadcast legal documents

indicators.note: broadcast means the word is heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: the Ritz is a famous London hotel

explanation.definitionFit: Writs are formal written court orders.

clue.text: Object to intellectual

explanation.definitionFit: To mind is to object; a mind is also a person of great intellect.

clue.text: Prepare costume

definitions.meaning: to make ready, as in preparing food or a wound
an outfit, as in fancy costume

explanation.definitionFit: Dressing a salad prepares it, and a frock or outfit is also called by this name.

clue.text: Clip about Asian island's primitive behaviour

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: to trim is to clip
Bali is an Indonesian island; the 's gives the S

explanation.surface: Clipping an Asian island's primitive customs.
explanation.definitionFit: Tribalism is loyalty to one's tribe, often seen as unsophisticated group behaviour.

clue.text: You support a child

parts.note: to second a motion is to support it
per means a, as in 'ten pounds per hour'
a son is a child

explanation.surface: You back a child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' looks like a link; it is PER, as in 'so much a head'.
explanation.definitionFit: Grammatically, the pronoun 'you' is the form used to address someone directly.
